text:
Anna M.: Quick postmortem follow-up — sharing the short summary and concrete action items for Atlas (dedicated/private). TL;DR: VPC peering flaps + on-prem isolation agent bug caused ~4h degraded throughput. Root cause: intermittent BGP neighbor resets on customer edge + our isolation agent treated route churn as tenant break, triggering broad isolation. Need owners, ETAs, and detection improvements.

Anna M.: Action items (proposed)
• Peering stabilization plan (routing policy + BGP keepalive tuning) — owner? ETA?
• Isolation agent hotfix (debounce logic + tighter route validation) — owner? ETA?
• Runbook updates & post-deploy smoke tests for on-prem peering — owner?
• Alerts/recurrence detection (route-flap alert -> auto ticket + pager) — owner?
• Customer coordination (maintenance window + validation) — owner?

Mike K.: I can own the peering stabilization. Will run policy change + test in staging.
Mike K.: ETA: 2 weeks for staged rollout (policy + keepalive), + 3-day verification window. I’ll create a preflight checklist.

Sanjay P.: I’ll take the isolation agent hotfix. Quick plan: (1) debounce route-change events (2) add ASN & prefix sanity checks (3) unit + infra integration tests.
Sanjay P.: ETA: hotfix in 5 business days, full integration tests + canary in 12 days.

rdw-bot: Jira tickets created — RDW-2345 (peering-stabilization) and RDW-2346 (isolation-agent-hotfix). Links: https://jira.redwood.example/browse/RDW-2345 , https://jira.redwood.example/browse/RDW-2346

Eli (ops): I’ll own the runbook updates and the smoke test harness. Will add a pre/post checklist and a small terraform plan to spin a test peer.
Eli (ops): Also adding alerting: route-flap rule -> open RDW incident + create pinned ticket. Proposal: alert if >3 BGP resets in 10m for a peer.

Rachel L.: I’ll coordinate customer-side scheduling with Atlas. Need confirmation of maintenance window ASAP. I can do a 2-hour validation window after we push the peering policy.

Mike K.: Preflight snippet (staging BGP check):
```
# check BGP neighbors on spine01
ssh ops@spine01 'vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors" | grep "Neighbor"'
```

Sanjay P.: Test harness quick command to simulate route churn:
```
# run on test-router
for i in {1..5}; do ip route add 10.10.0.0/16 via 192.0.2.$((100 + $i)); sleep 30; ip route del 10.10.0.0/16; done
```

Anna M.: Notes on prioritization: label RDW-2345 as prio:high and RDW-2346 as prio:critical (hotfix blocks other remediation). We should avoid a full tenant isolation rollback in prod unless customer OKs it.

Eli (ops): Will add detection playbook to alerts and wire up auto-ticket (RDW-2347) for any recurrence. Also will add a dashboard tile for peer flaps last 30d.

rdw-bot: Calendar event created: "Atlas peering remediation sync" on 2210011200 (calendar invite sent to @Mike K., @Sanjay P., @Rachel L., @Anna M., @Eli (ops)).

Anna M.: Confirm owners and ETAs here by EOD. If any blockers, flag now.

Mike K.: Confirmed — owner RDW-2345, ETA 2 weeks.
Sanjay P.: Confirmed — owner RDW-2346, ETA 5 business days for hotfix.
Eli (ops): Confirmed — runbook + alerts in 3 business days.
Rachel L.: Confirmed I’ll get customer maintenance window by tomorrow EOD.

Anna M.: Thanks. I’ll update the postmortem with these owners and close the follow-up loop. I’ll also add a recurring monthly check for peering stability for Atlas. :thumbsup:

Mike K.: small follow-up: can we add a canary route before full rollout? prefer /24 that doesn’t hit production.
Sanjay P.: yeah, canary route + canary tenant. I’ll include tests in the canary pipeline.

Anna M.: Great — closing the thread for now. If anything changes, reply here and I’ll propagate to the PM and CSM.
